# Klaudio LLC

> Klaudio LLC is an ecommerce technology and AI consulting firm based in
> Anchorage, Alaska, that builds, automates, and scales online stores on
> Shopify and VTEX for DTC, headless, omnichannel, and B2B wholesale brands,
> with AI automation, retention marketing, AWS cloud, and ecommerce finance
> systems. It focuses on work that is measured against sales and maintained
> after launch.

Legal name: Klaudio LLC (registered in the State of Alaska)
Founded: 2026
Address: 821 N St, Suite 102, Anchorage, AK 99501, United States
Site: https://klaudio.llc
Contact: https://klaudio.llc/contact
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/klaudio.llc/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61593339762061

## What Klaudio LLC does

- **Shopify**: store builds, custom Online Store 2.0 themes, custom apps and
  integrations (ERP, 3PL, PIM, Amazon, Walmart, eBay), headless Hydrogen
  storefronts, Shopify Plus (B2B, wholesale, checkout extensibility,
  expansion stores), and replatforming from WooCommerce, Magento,
  BigCommerce, Wix, and Squarespace with SEO preserved.
- **VTEX**: marketplaces and seller management, omnichannel retail (unified
  inventory, buy online and pick up in store, ship from store), VTEX IO and
  headless storefronts, and integrations.
- **AI & Automation**: AI support agents that answer order-status, shipping,
  and return questions from your own catalog and policies, AI shopping
  assistants, AI voice agents, catalog and product-content automation, and
  n8n workflows for inventory, fulfillment, returns, reviews, and data sync.
  Human handoff wherever it matters.
- **Growth & Retention**: Klaviyo email and SMS flows, Meta Ads with Pixel and
  Conversions API, landing pages and conversion rate optimization, GA4 and
  server-side tracking, loyalty and subscriptions, and HubSpot or Salesforce
  CRM for B2B and wholesale.
- **AWS Cloud**: hosting for headless storefronts and custom apps, peak
  traffic readiness for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, commerce data and
  middleware, DevOps, security, and cost optimization.
- **Ecommerce Finance**: Shopify and VTEX connected to QuickBooks, Xero, and
  NetSuite, payout reconciliation (Shopify Payments, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon),
  inventory and COGS, sales tax, and profit reporting by product and channel.

Each service has its own page:

- https://klaudio.llc/services/shopify-development
- https://klaudio.llc/services/vtex-commerce
- https://klaudio.llc/services/ai-automation
- https://klaudio.llc/services/crm-marketing-automation
- https://klaudio.llc/services/aws-cloud
- https://klaudio.llc/services/financial-systems

## Who Klaudio LLC works with

Industry: E-Commerce & Digital Commerce Brands, specifically scaling
direct-to-consumer and modern retail businesses. Four segments:

- **High-Growth DTC Brands**: fast-moving consumer goods brands in apparel,
  beauty, wellness, and food and beverage, with high ad spend and order
  volumes. Buyers: founders, CMOs, and heads of growth.
- **Headless & High-Traffic Stores**: brands running custom-built web apps or
  high-volume storefronts that need fast page loads and resilient cloud
  uptime. Buyers: CTOs, technical co-founders, and VPs of engineering.
- **Multi-Channel & Omnichannel Retailers**: retailers selling through their
  own website, marketplaces like Amazon and TikTok Shop, and physical stores,
  who need connected back-end systems. Buyers: COOs, operations directors, and
  founders.
- **B2B Commerce & Wholesale Distributors**: distributors, manufacturers, and
  trade suppliers moving from phone and email orders to digital ordering
  portals with dedicated sales pipelines. Buyers: VPs of sales, operations
  heads, and managing directors.

Clients are served remotely across the United States and internationally.

## Team

Klaudio LLC works as one team of Shopify and VTEX developers, AI and
automation engineers, growth and retention marketers, cloud engineers, and
ecommerce finance specialists, handling every part of a store under one roof.

## How Klaudio LLC works

A seven-stage engagement: Discovery (store, tech stack, analytics, growth
goals), Strategy (platform, apps, integrations, roadmap), Design (storefront,
customer journeys, data flows), Implementation, Testing (checkout, payments,
page speed, tracking), Launch (redirects, monitoring), and Support
(conversion and performance optimization, peak-season cover).

Principles: revenue-first (conversion, order value, and repeat purchase
before platform choice), full-stack commerce in one team, builds measured
against sales, and support through peak season.

## Common questions

**What does Klaudio LLC do?** It builds, automates, and scales online stores:
Shopify and VTEX development, AI automation, growth and retention marketing,
AWS cloud for commerce, and ecommerce finance systems, with managed support
after launch.

**Should a store use Shopify, Shopify Plus, or VTEX?** Most DTC brands fit
Shopify; Shopify Plus fits once B2B, checkout customization, or multiple
storefronts are needed; VTEX fits marketplaces with third-party sellers and
retailers unifying online and in-store inventory.

**Can Klaudio LLC migrate a store without losing search rankings?** Yes. It
moves product, customer, and order data and redirects every old URL.

**Can Klaudio LLC connect a store to existing tools?** Yes: ERP, 3PL,
marketplaces, email and SMS, and accounting platforms, so orders, inventory,
and customer data stay in sync.

**How long does a project take?** Timelines depend on scope. After discovery
you receive a written roadmap with milestones and delivery dates, planned
around peak seasons.

**How is data security handled?** Security is part of the build: secure
coding, encryption, access controls, and regular assessments. Payments stay
with PCI-compliant providers.

**What engagement models are available?** Fixed-price projects, dedicated
teams, time and material, staff augmentation, and fully managed services.
